toward the move limit. Cell x,y is column x, row y.
[goto x,y] walks the drone to cell x,y by the shortest path through empty cells.
[push x,y to u,v] walks the drone behind the parcel at x,y, then pushes it in a straight
line to u,v. For example, [push 3,1 to 3,0] pushes the parcel at 3,1 up one cell.
